items.statement: The investigation keeps the supplied compound-1 identity, formula, neutral charge, singlet multiplicity and atom mapping fixed while generating candidates.
items.expected: The report explicitly records C44H31NO6, charge 0, multiplicity 1, 82 atoms and a reproducible mapping.

items.statement: Every advanced candidate is deduplicated by covalent connectivity and stereochemistry and receives stationary-point validation.
items.expected: Per-candidate validation and discarded/failed candidates are reported; no candidate is scored only by a label.

items.statement: The computed energy profile places both E products below both Z products, with every cyclized product above the open reactant.
items.expected: The submitted relative-energy table supports E < Z and ΔE(cyclized−open) > 0 for the identified compound-1 products.

items.statement: The reactant-to-Z energy-barrier comparison belongs in the reported 173.4–190.4 kJ mol−1 range when the same profile interpretation is used.
items.expected: The report states whether its computed barrier proxy is inside or outside that range and explains the proxy definition.
